inputs.goal: build awareness for a new collection
inputs.visual_style: retro pink scrapbook poster, y2k, glitter stickers

audience_facts: Source: 1962 YouTube comments on all three brands combined video ads.
Predicted sentiment: 63% positive, 35% neutral, 2% negative (negative comments are under-detected).
42% of comments mention the song or music.
1% mention price, 0% quality, 1% delivery or availability.
17% of comments contain a question or request.
guidance: Viewers talk a lot about music in video ads, so choose the music mood on purpose. Do not claim the product is for music lovers.
Price is rarely discussed, so do not lead with price; evidence for price messaging is weak.
Few comments discuss the clothes, so show the product clearly; evidence on design preferences is thin.

brief.headline: Shifi ka naya pink swag!
brief.caption: Retro vibes aur glittery style! Shifi ki yeh pink graphic tee bohot zabardast hai. Naya collection aa gaya hai!
brief.image_prompt: A model wearing a pink graphic tee, product clearly visible, simple background, retro pink scrapbook poster style, y2k aesthetic, glitter stickers, no extra props, no text, no logos
brief.why: Based on 1,962 YouTube comments on all three brands combined video ads (not this brand's own audience): 42% mention the music, so the music mood is a deliberate choice. Only 1% mention price, so the ad does not lead with price (the evidence either way is weak). Only 7% discuss the clothes, so the product is shown clearly.
